objectives.statement: The tranche-4 record sets are evidenced and their manifests green: T9 and T10 first (PI plan, PI objectives, retro lesson), then T4, T14, T16, S05, S07, S09, T19 and T18. All ten carry meta.tranche 4; the PI refinement records each member's four WSJF inputs.

The seven deep-review findings are packages and their fixes land: the governed_assets family, the action-registry and licensing projections, the shared_config and retro-lesson record writes, the register-field standard and the T18 harness.
The v1 verdict is re-executed at the head: every absent or partial slice is packaged, and the eight record-only receipts gain an executed SPEC proof.
The CODE P0 and P1 bundles execute: every closed package names a commit and a test, and the register's open CODE count falls.
The pack is republished from the live rows; all 74 output-standard categories are mapped and checked; viability is re-run.
The next tranche is prepared only where the record supports it; no artefact is generated from rows that do not exist.
